howto.when: 当你提到“dbt”、“SQL”、“数据库”等关键词时，Claude会立即启用此技能处理数据库任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically detects database or dbt-related requests and uses SignalPilot tools to perform governed read-only queries, schema discovery, SQL validation, and dbt project workflows.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like "dbt", "SQL", "database", or "data pipeline", Claude invokes this skill as the first tool call for database tasks.
